name: post.mark
description: Sets a post's stage by hand, as the idea page does: draft, scheduled or posted. Kept apart from publishing: jobs not yet sent are cancelled, an account already live stays live. Scheduled needs a day and an account; posted is final.
sql:
with p as (select * from brandbase.posts where id = :id and brand_id = :brand and brandbase.post_stage(id) <> :stage),
cancelled as (delete from brandbase.post_jobs j using p where j.post_id = p.id and j.status <> 'live' returning j.id),
marked as (
  update brandbase.posts x set marked = case when :stage = 'draft' then null else :stage end,
    version = x.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from p where x.id = p.id
  returning x.*
)
select brandbase.post_json(to_jsonb(m), coalesce((
  select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j)) from brandbase.post_jobs j where j.post_id = m.id and j.status = 'live'), '[]')) as result
from marked m
union all
select brandbase.post_json(x) from brandbase.posts x
where x.id = :id and x.brand_id = :brand and not exists (select 1 from p)
